name: agent-loop
description: Autonomous coding loop for long-running tasks (refactors, new features, test sweeps). A bash harness owns exclusivity and liveness (lock + heartbeat + structured lifecycle events), re-invokes a fresh headless tick per task for OS-level context reset, supervises a browser dashboard sidecar, and on incidents runs a budgeted /agent-loop-medic that repairs only from an allowlist and hands over to a human (NEEDS_HUMAN.md, exit 2) when it cannot. Handles blockers with a taxonomy and builds dynamic sprint contracts per task. Requires the superpowers plugin; bundles the postmortem plugin and recommends the permissions plugin for its /permissions-advisor pre-flight check.
